# object code 3) at the flag 15,9 and the remove click on its node. Its flag pointer (+0xe) is set by hand, as a built site leaves it

# the castle's knights (s6 to s8) are left out. A scenario has the worker inside waiting for a log (sawmill-inside), sawing (sawmill-sawing,
# a log lies on the castle's flag from the pass 600), or stepping out with the plank (sawmill-out). Not production code: no routine of the
# program is transcribed here, only values the program produced.
